text: {"lessons":["After selling Stock A and B, I later bought them back at higher prices; I should avoid selling just to realize a gain and set clear reasons for both selling and re-entry.","Buying more after an earlier purchase should depend on the stock’s role and risk in my whole portfolio, not simply on wanting to lower its average cost.","My account has grown overall, but ten periods and a few trades are too little evidence to judge a strategy; I should stay patient and make deliberate, diversified decisions."]}
